validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="x" expr="1" src="file:x.json"/><data id="y" expr="2">3</data></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<data>` declares more than one value source: `expr` and `src`
notes: `<data>` gets its initial value from exactly one of `src` (a URI), `expr` (an expression), or inline child content; with several the value is ambiguous
diagnostics.help: keep one value source: remove `src`, or remove `expr`

diagnostics.message: `<data>` declares more than one value source: `expr` and the child content
notes: `<data>` gets its initial value from exactly one of `src` (a URI), `expr` (an expression), or inline child content; with several the value is ambiguous
diagnostics.help: keep one value source: remove `expr`, or remove the child content
